findings.problem: The bare English prompt club also means a weapon (el garrote, la porra) or a golf club (el palo), so with no hint more than one Spanish answer is right.
findings.fix: hint: an association or team, as in a soccer club

back.es: club (a group or association of members, e.g. a sports club or social club; also a nightclub)
back.example: My brother plays on/for a soccer club.

note: The plural is clubes (clubs is also heard), which might be worth showing to learners.
